user.title: Connect Zendure device
user.description: Enter the IP address of the Zendure device (zenSDK local API must be available) and select the sensor that reports your net grid power in W (positive = import, negative = export).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device. Check the IP address and that the local API (zenSDK) is enabled.
error.no_serial: The device did not report a serial number.

abort.no_serial: The device did not report a serial number.

data_description.battery_order: Optional. Order of the battery packs as semicolon separated indexes, for example 2;1;3. Leave empty for the order reported by the device.

error.wrong_device: This IP address belongs to a different device.
